```
['run the python module to resolve and print the correct setuptools-scm version tag for the current git commit', 'run the python module with --tag-only to print just the highest version tag sorted by PEP 440 ordering', 'test the parse_version_tuple function to verify PEP 440 sorting of version tags with rc and post suffixes', 'test the get_exact_version_tag function to check if the current HEAD commit has an exact version tag', 'test the get_latest_version_tag_describe function to build a describe string for untagged commits relative to the latest tag']
```

